capabilities: Convert checked tasks into individual Markdown notes
Add optional properties for topic, status, completion date, heading path, source, and content
Write cleaned task text into the note body without checkbox or heading
Apply custom regex cleanup rules to generated notes
Run conversion manually from the command palette
extras: Manual installation only (copy main.js, manifest.json, styles.css); no community plugin store instructions. Existing Topic Task Archiver archive notes are not migrated.
intentEvidence: Version 2.0 changes the storage model from one archive note per topic to one note per completed task.
problem: Obsidian leaves completed tasks as lines in a note, so there is no built-in way to turn each finished task into its own queryable note.
summary: Task-to-note converter that turns checked tasks into individual Markdown notes with topic, completion date, and source properties for Bases and search.
